strongest_angle: Investigating how the Principle of Sufficient Reason and Russellian monism are deployed by contemporary philosophers to argue that consciousness is a fundamental feature of reality.

key_facts.fact: Author Sam Kimpton-Nye explores how the principle of sufficient reason motivates panpsychism in an essay published by Aeon in October 2026.

Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy contributors Philip Goff, William Seager, and Sean Allen-Hermanson note that hostility to metaphysics in Western philosophy has gradually receded since the 1970s, reviving interest in panpsychism.
A 2024 article published in Erkenntnis by Springer Nature examines how Russellian monist panpsychism attempts to explain mental causation compared to alternative non-physicalist theories.
Benedikt Paul Göcke discusses Joanna Leidenhag's 2022 theological work Minding Creation, which argues that panpsychism is logically consistent with theism.
